notes: Target reports itself as the deliberately vulnerable lab mode. Failures are expected and demonstrate detectable weaknesses.
limitations: EffectProof requires the target to expose a restricted test-state interface (the HookProof lab provides one). Internal effects of an arbitrary API cannot be observed without suitable instrumentation.
HookProof only scans explicitly allowed hosts; the default allow-list is loopback.
The MVP includes a single event type (payment.succeeded) and a single 'core' suite.
Timing/race findings are probabilistic: a clean concurrent test does not prove the absence of a race under all conditions.

results.title: Valid signed event is processed
results.description: A correctly signed, fresh payment event must be accepted and must create exactly one payment business operation.
results.expected: exactly one payment of 1000; order status 'paid'
results.remediation: Investigate the webhook handler, signature verification and payload validation. A valid event should result in one processed operation.

results.title: Unsigned event does not change protected state
results.description: An event without any signature header must be rejected and must not create or modify protected business records.
results.expected: no payment recorded and amount_total remains 0 (no protected side effect)
results.remediation: Require and verify a signature header on every webhook request before processing. Reject unsigned requests with 401.

results.title: Forged signature is rejected without side effects
results.description: A request signed with the wrong secret must be rejected and must not trigger processing.
results.expected: no payment recorded and amount_total remains 0 (no protected side effect)
results.remediation: Verify signatures with a constant-time comparison against the expected HMAC and reject mismatches with 401 before any side effect.

results.title: Tampered payload is rejected without side effects
results.description: A signed body whose content was modified (without recomputing a valid signature) must not be processed.
results.expected: no payment recorded and amount_total remains 0 (no protected side effect)
results.remediation: Sign the raw request body and verify it before parsing. Never trust fields that were not covered by the signature.

results.title: Unsupported event type does not move money
results.description: A correctly signed event whose type is not supported (for example a refund event) must not trigger a payment fulfilment.
results.expected: no payment recorded and amount_total remains 0 (no protected side effect)
results.remediation: Accept only explicitly supported event types and reject or ignore unknown types before any business logic runs.

results.title: Negative amount is rejected without side effects
results.description: A signed event with an invalid (negative) amount must be rejected and must not create a payment or alter protected state.
results.expected: no payment recorded and amount_total remains 0 (no protected side effect)
results.remediation: Validate amount boundaries (positive, within expected limits) before processing, and reject invalid payloads with 422.

results.title: Duplicate delivery creates only one business operation
results.description: Delivering the same valid event twice must produce exactly one protected business operation (persistent idempotency).
results.expected: exactly one payment of 1000 after two identical deliveries
results.remediation: Persist event IDs and make the business operation idempotent using a unique constraint plus a transaction. Return a safe success for already-processed events instead of repeating the operation.
notes: the duplicate was acknowledged successfully yet the operation was repeated, which is the dangerous case

results.title: Concurrent duplicate deliveries cannot bypass idempotency
results.description: Simultaneous copies of the same valid event must still result in exactly one protected business operation.
results.expected: exactly one payment of 1000 after 8 concurrent deliveries
results.remediation: Enforce idempotency at the database level (unique event ID constraint) inside an immediate/atomic transaction so that concurrent deliveries cannot each create a payment.
notes: 8 payments were created, indicating a race condition that bypassed idempotency controls

results.title: Event ID cannot be reused for another order
results.description: Reusing an already processed event ID with a different order must not create a second protected business operation.
results.expected: original order charged once; reused event ID creates no payment for the second order
results.remediation: Make the idempotency ledger global to the event ID (unique constraint), not scoped per order, and reject reused IDs atomically.
notes: the same event ID was applied to a different order, so the idempotency ledger is scoped incorrectly

results.title: Stale signed timestamp is rejected
results.description: A correctly signed event whose authenticated timestamp is outside the freshness window must be rejected and cause no side effects.
results.expected: no payment recorded and amount_total remains 0 (no protected side effect)
results.remediation: Reject events whose authenticated timestamp is outside the accepted freshness window (for example +/- 300 seconds) and record a replay guard for accepted event IDs.

results.title: Malformed payload causes no unintended state change
results.description: Invalid JSON and structurally invalid events (including with a valid signature) must be handled safely without side effects.
results.expected: no payment recorded for malformed payloads
results.remediation: Validate JSON parsing and every required field before processing, and respond with 400/422 without touching business state.
